name: Musou no Haramase Onaho Kishidan ~Tsuyoi Mesu o Jutsu de Kuppuku Sasete Ero Hidoi Koto Yaritai Houdai no Zettai Chuusei Harem o Tsukuru!~
original_name: 無双の孕ませオナホ騎士団 　～強い牝を淫紋術で屈服させてエロ酷いことやりたい放題の絶対忠誠ハーレムを作る！～
source:
A world where beautiful and strong female knights fight for supremacy.
The main character, a meager knight, has his home country destroyed by the knights led by the sadistic female knight Carla, and ends up wandering into the forest for his life. 
However, there he encounters a magic sword that turns his desire into power!

"I want to crush the female knights, impregnate them, and turn them into onhaoles"

The main character, who is impressed by the magnitude of the desire he has harbored for many years, makes a contract with the magic sword and learns the lewd spell that allows him to control the person he carves into his will!

The protagonist, who has acquired the power to make his desires come true, carves lewd marks on the female knights with big breasts and big butts from all over the world, starting with the exiled princess knight Erica, one after another, and makes them submit by impregnating them with creampie.

The protagonist, who has been sworn allegiance by the Onahole Knights, becomes the master of one of the world's greatest powers and rises even further.

translation:
美丽而坚强的女骑士争夺霸权的世界。
主人公是一位贫穷的骑士，他的祖国被虐待狂女骑士卡拉率领的骑士团摧毁，最终流浪到森林中求生。
然而，在那里他遇到了一把将他的欲望转化为力量的魔剑！

“我想粉碎女骑士，让她们怀孕，然后把她们变成onhaoles”

主人公对自己多年来所怀有的欲望的强烈感到印象深刻，与魔剑签订了契约，并学习了淫荡的咒语，可以让他控制他刻入意志的人！

获得了实现愿望的力量的主人公，从流亡公主骑士艾丽卡开始，在全世界的巨乳巨臀女骑士身上刻下淫荡的印记，并用中出让她们屈服。

受到奥纳霍尔骑士团宣誓效忠的主人公，成为世界上最强大的力量之一的主人，并进一步崛起。
